notes: This bilingual edited passage explicitly names individuals born on each of twenty days, unlike 1722 K'iche' AHILABALZIH untranslated source.
Multiple same ancestral literary traditions should not be counted as repeated independent proof of astrological predictiveness.

Source title and labels use historical Yucatec spelling; a K'iche' visually identical or semantically related label can mean a different day. Yucatec Kan corresponds K'iche' K'at; K'iche' Kan instead corresponds Yucatec Chicchan.
The three-day artisan cluster is a modern investigator construct, not a literal pre-existing Yucatec rule. The original source Chuen-only forecast is stronger for fidelity.
A short feasibility pilot can test the process but not demonstrate a moderate effect at realistic 5% single-day prevalence without adequate sample size or enrichment.
Modern world direction assignments were inserted by editor, using codex cross-references; omit from natal test.
